Contact Mason Park Dental of Katy

We’re here to answer all your dental questions and guide you on the path to perfect oral health. At Mason Park Dental of Katy, your comfort and care are our top priorities. Reach out to us for any inquiries or to schedule an appointment with our compassionate dental team, including Dr. William Sung, Dr. Dave Cho, and Dr. Tam Nguyen

Whether it’s a simple check-up, a complex procedure, or a question about pediatric dentistry, we’re here to help. Our doors are open to the Katy community and beyond. Contact Mason Park Dental of Katy today — where your smile is our mission.
We are located at the corner of Mason Rd and Kingsland Blvd, behind the Ranch 99 complex.
Send us a message and the front desk will come back to you.
